title: Books
text: Nothing Matters Nothing Matters looks at how absence shapes philosophy, science, language, art, and psychology from the ancient Greeks to the quantum age. Under The Cross A gritty and uncompromising crime story set in Sydney and Bangkok, It’s a novelette that sends you on a short, fast ride to a thrilling and dangerous location. Five Ways A comic story of aliens who help a young woman find love. The Damaged – A Sydney Story A writer meets a homeless woman on the streets of Sydney and falls in love, but then he steals her stories and publishes them under his name as his life falls apart. The Disease A bird with H1N1 virus (bird flu) comes into contact with a HIV positive man, which sets off events that spiral into international political murder. Painted. Two lives of art and music painted across the page. Coming Soon.

title: About
text: Rob J Kennedy Rob J Kennedy is a Canberra based writer and composer whose work spans music, philosophy, fiction, poetry, and the arts. He currently writes concert and visual art reviews for Limelight and CityNews. Rob also teaches philosophy at The University of the Third Age. Music has been part of Rob’s life since childhood, when he first played the flute. He has since played several instruments and is largely self-taught. Progressive rock shaped his early listening and writing, before he discovered classical music and bought his first piano at 18. Today, his compositions draw on post-classical music, jazz, baroque music, and Russian composers, particularly Sergei Prokofiev. He is especially drawn to the expressive range of the orchestra. For Rob, music and writing are a way of communicating what it feels like to be alive.
